title: s500-literature-201: Whole-night hippocampal depth and scalp Cz sleep EEG with spindle and ripple detections, 14 epilepsy patients (Ngo, Fell & Staresina, 2020) (derivative)
description: Whole-night sleep recordings from 14 pre-surgical epilepsy patients (135.6 h in total), comprising a posterior hippocampal depth contact and scalp Cz recorded at 1 kHz. The derivative dataset repackages the authors' released data into BIDS and includes sleep scoring, artifact intervals, and automated ripple and spindle detections. It supports investigation of hippocampal-neocortical coupling between sleep spindles and long-duration ripples during sleep.
methods_description: Two channels per patient were recorded overnight at 1 kHz: a hippocampal depth contact in the non-pathological hemisphere (the contact with the highest spindle density) and scalp Cz. Both were referenced to linked mastoids with a hardware band-pass of 0.01-300 Hz. Sleep was scored following Rechtschaffen & Kales criteria, and ripples and spindles were found with the authors' automated detectors.

funding_references.funder_name: ERC Starting Grant 'RECALL' (Staresina, as acknowledged in the article)
